newsitem.title: MEXICO: Penoles decides against buying 60 pct of La Oroya.
newsitem.headline: Penoles decides against buying 60 pct of La Oroya.

text.p: Mexican silver giant Industrias Penoles said on Thursday it informed the Peruvian government it decided not to acquire a 60 percent stake in the La Oroya (Metaloroya) metallurgic complex, the company said in a statement.
"The decision was made because the requirements that Penoles had set to guarantee adequate profitability did not come together," Penoles said.
Penoles agreed two months ago to buy the stake for about $34 million, with additional investments of almost $193 million planned, according to Peruvian state miner Centromin.
Centromin was to keep a 40 percent stake in the refinery and smelter complex in the Andes.
In the statement, Penoles said it would continue to look for mining and metallurgic investments in Peru and Latin America "to achieve important synergies for added value."
A Penoles spokesman said more details on the decision would be provided at a later date.
